rules: These cases must not be read by the P5.1 builder or used for rule selection, parameter fitting, or domain changes.
After P5 v2 is frozen, preflight must create numerical predictions before any P6-v2 kernel is compiled or run.
Each family runs in three independent processes; compile, correctness, and timing failures remain distinct from model error.
The original P6 results are retrospective diagnostics only and cannot determine P5.1 parameters.
